crime_highlights: Mr. Beynon admits that he committed the offence of manslaughter of Ms. Monk by repeatedly striking her in the head or on the head with a bottle.
Ms. Monk was transported to Vancouver General Hospital but died from her injuries on February 8, 2022.
An autopsy confirmed that the cause of her death was blunt force trauma to the head.
Ms. Monk was diagnosed on an interim basis with extensive intracranial bleeding with hemorrhagic stroke, with extensive lacerations on the face, head, and facial swelling.
rationale_highlights: he is a descendent of a number of residential school survivors, including his mother
I have considered the Gladue principles to be applied in this case.
the impact of intergenerational trauma resulting from Mr. Beynon's Indigenous background is something that the court is able to consider in determining the extent of his moral culpability
note: Court says it may consider trauma for culpability; never states reduction.

crime_highlights: Mr. Willness struck Mr. Young on the head with his skateboard
Mr. Young suffered severe head injuries, which resulted in his death four days later in hospital.
Mr. K. Tait said Mr. Willness swung the skateboard like a baseball bat with a tremendous amount of force.
There was a loud crack that sounded like a gun going off.
rationale_highlights: Mr. Willness' family was afflicted by many of the same harms that Indigenous people and families too often experience
I do, however, think that there is a very strong relationship between the challenges Mr. Willness faced growing up and the offence which brings him before the court.
I have no difficulty finding that those adverse childhood experiences played a very significant role in his offending behaviour
Those factors do reduce to some degree his moral culpability for the very serious offence he committed.
note: Cherokee heritage; disconnection; conclusion at para 93.

crime_highlights: Mr. Reed fired a total of seven rounds from a handgun into the restaurant through a large exterior glass window
Mr. Reed fired a single shot through the window and into the back of Mr. Zhu's head
The first shot was a targeted shot intended to kill.
Mr. Zhu immediately collapsed after being shot and died later in hospital.
rationale_highlights: Background and systemic factors are therefore similarly relevant to sentencing offenders of African descent.
some of Mr. Reed's poor decisions in the past have been reactive to incidents of racism and bigotry directed towards him. I accept that submission.
note: Court accepts racism context; never says it reduces culpability; para 10 is long.
